description: This source file defines functions and data structures for handling git tree objects, including decoding, initializing, updating, traversing, and searching tree entries within a git repository. It manages tree descriptors, path traversal, and matching tree entries against pathspecs, along with handling symlinks and tree traversal statistics.

methods.name: int decode_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,const char * buf,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Decodes a tree entry from a buffer, extracting its path, mode, and object ID, and populates the tree descriptor accordingly.

methods.name: int init_tree_desc_internal(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err,enum tree_desc_flags flags)
methods.description: Initializes a tree descriptor with a given object ID and buffer, decoding the first entry if present.

methods.name: void init_tree_desc(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Initializes a tree descriptor and dies on error.

methods.name: int init_tree_desc_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size,enum tree_desc_flags flags)
methods.description: Initializes a tree descriptor and reports errors rather than dying.

methods.name: void * fill_tree_descriptor(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the repository into a buffer, initializes a descriptor, and returns the buffer.

methods.name: void entry_clear(struct name_entry * a)
methods.description: Clears a name_entry structure to defaults.

methods.name: void entry_extract(struct tree_desc * t,struct name_entry * a)
methods.description: Copies the current entry from a tree descriptor into a name_entry.

methods.name: int update_tree_entry_internal(struct tree_desc * desc,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Updates the tree descriptor buffer to the next entry, decoding it.

methods.name: void update_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc)
methods.description: Updates the current tree entry, dying on error.

methods.name: int update_tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc)
methods.description: Updates the current entry and reports errors instead of dying.

methods.name: int tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Retrieves the current tree entry and advances to the next.

methods.name: int tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Retrieves the current tree entry and advances, reporting errors.

methods.name: void trace2_traverse_trees_statistics_atexit(void)
methods.description: Outputs JSON statistics about tree traversal to trace2.

methods.name: void setup_traverse_info(struct traverse_info * info,const char * base)
methods.description: Initializes traversal info with a base path and manages depth tracking.

methods.name: char * make_traverse_path(char * path,size_t pathlen,const struct traverse_info * info,const char * name,size_t namelen)
methods.description: Constructs a full traverse path string from info and name components.

methods.name: void strbuf_make_traverse_path(struct strbuf * out,const struct traverse_info * info,const char * name,size_t namelen)
methods.description: Builds a traverse path into a strbuf based on traversal info and a name.

methods.name: int traverse_trees(struct index_state * istate,int n,struct tree_desc * t,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Traverses a set of tree descriptors, applying a callback for each relevant entry, managing depth, and handling subtrees and symlinks.

methods.name: int find_tree_entry(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * t,const char * name,struct object_id * result,unsigned short * mode)
methods.description: Finds a tree entry by name within a tree descriptor, returning its object ID and mode.

methods.name: int get_tree_entry(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * name,struct object_id * oid,unsigned short * mode)
methods.description: Retrieves a tree entry object ID and mode by name within a repository's tree object.

methods.name: enum:get_oid_result get_tree_entry_follow_symlinks(struct repository * r,struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * name,struct object_id * result,struct strbuf * result_path,unsigned short * mode)
methods.description: Follows symlink chains to locate a tree entry, may return outside-repo paths.
